precedence: Newest explicit release scope requires original mandatory V2 plus all DIF and IMAGE-COMIC items in one Release Gate.

spec_status.PLANNED: Full newly added requirement is not certified implemented; linked existing partial reuse may already exist.
spec_status.IMPLEMENTED: Full requirement has code, without claiming full integration or final acceptance.
spec_status.INTEGRATION_VERIFIED: Full requirement has exact-source integration evidence.
spec_status.BLOCKED: A specific unresolved dependency blocks the requirement.

acceptance_status.NOT_ACCEPTED: This ledger has no full formal acceptance evidence for this requirement. Historical focused passes remain valid at their original boundaries.
